concerns.action: 0006 inventories + DROPs/rewrites every legacy campus/staff/parent SELECT policy on evidence/identity/view tables (RLS OR-combines -> legacy policies are bypass paths). Recreate only family/guardian/RPC policies. Separate coach (severity-bands only, NO raw) from campus_admin/super_admin. Flip the existing rls_deny_cases.sql tests that assert coach raw access -> deny.

No generic caller whitelist on the shared forbid_mutation trigger. Revised trigger allows the operation ONLY when a txn-local GUC flag (app.erase_in_progress) is set AND row.data_class is operational_child_pii; the flag is settable only inside the SECURITY DEFINER erase RPC (EXECUTE granted only to the server role). Deny tests: direct owner/service update/delete still blocked; erasing non-operational classes blocked.

assert_can_access_student(actor_uid, student_id) reads guardians + family membership + guardian role + court_order + dual_consent + active consent FROM TABLES at call time. JWT provides only auth.uid() (actor identity), never authorizes a family/role by itself.

submit_attempt binds (student_id, session_id, item_id, item_version, nonce) together: derive session_id from the served_attempt_nonces record, enforce attempt row + session row + nonce all share the same student_id+session_id before grading or inserting evidence.

Authoritative grade + append-only attempt insert stay synchronous + transactional. The model/mastery update is enqueued as a model_update_outbox row IN THE SAME TRANSACTION as the attempt insert; a worker applies it idempotently (replayable from attempts) with retry/dead-letter. Acceptance: simulated async-failure test proves the attempt is never orphaned from mastery state.

Operational child PII is ANONYMIZED-IN-PLACE (COPPA permits irreversible anonymization), not hard-deleted — sidesteps the ON DELETE RESTRICT FK graph (mastery_updates.attempt_id, messages.attempt_id, *.session_id) and preserves the academic record. Per-class behavior table defines anonymize vs tombstone vs preserve (consent/audit preserved). Scratch-DB FK test seeds linked rows + proves erase completes without FK violation or touching non-operational classes.

Sensitive staff/admin reads move behind read_student_record(student_id, reason_code) SECURITY DEFINER RPC that inserts the audit row (actor, subject, reason, ip/device hash) in the SAME txn BEFORE returning data; drop direct super_admin/staff SELECT on sensitive tables. (Break-glass RPC contract lands in Ph1; full read-path migration completes alongside reporting in Ph7.)

Add served_attempt_nonces(session_id,item_id,item_version,params_hash,nonce,expires_at,consumed_at) UNIQUE(nonce), UNIQUE(session_id,item_id,nonce); atomic consume inside submit_attempt. Deny tests: replay (consumed), expired, wrong session, wrong item_version, tampered params_hash.

note: All 8 adopted; none over-engineered (each closes a real isolation/integrity/replay hole the BLOCKER schema must have). Plan revised to v2 before implementation.
